title: Steel Doors and Gates in Pakistan | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Sliding, hinged and rolling steel doors and gates for factories, farms and warehouses in Pakistan. Made to your size by Steel Mind Engineers.
keyword: steel doors and gates in Pakistan
h1: Steel Doors and Gates in Pakistan: Strong Entrances for Factories, Farms and Warehouses
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers fabricates sliding gates, hinged gates, rolling doors and personnel doors to your opening size. They are built with strong frames, suitable hardware and a coating that resists rust.
alt: Wide steel sliding gate at a factory entrance in Pakistan.

faq.q: Can Steel Mind Engineers make doors for an existing building?
faq.a: Yes. An engineer will measure the opening on site.

faq.q: Which door suits a loading dock?
faq.a: A rolling or sectional door usually suits a dock best.

items.name: Sliding gates
items.text: Run on a rail and save swing space, which suits factory entrances.

items.name: Hinged gates
items.text: Swing on pillars and suit farms and small sites.

items.name: Rolling doors
items.text: Roll up above the opening and suit warehouses and docks.

items.name: Personnel doors
items.text: Smaller doors for people, fitted into large doors or walls.

blocks.text: Measure the opening from the largest vehicle or machine that must pass. The frame must resist wind and daily handling. Rollers, hinges and locks must suit the weight of the door. A good coating stops rust. See Painting. Motors and remote controls can be added where daily use is heavy.
Doors for PEB buildings are designed with the frame, so the opening and the supports fit. See Accessories.
